notes.title: WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43476298/3118fdaccd7dcb419b6a79cf96e333c83c11d248.png[/img]

[h2]WDC World Ocean Day Charity Sale [/h2]

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save a fin-tastic 60% off Rocket and 70% off Drop It: Block Paradise. We will also donate 50% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.*

[h2]Who are WDC?[/h2]

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these majestic beings. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.

[h2]What is ghost gear?[/h2]

Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. 

When a whale or dolphin gets tangled in it, it can kill them in the most horrific way, by preventing them from getting to the surface to breathe. Or they can carry it for days, weeks or even months suffering a slow and painful death as it cuts into their skin, restricts their movement and hampers their ability to hunt and feed. 

But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.

Did you know that about 1/3 of marine litter found in European seas is discarded fishing gear? That's estimated to be over 11,000 tonnes entering the sea each year!

It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

[h2]How your support will help this year[/h2]

By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring, intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year. 

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: [url=https://whales.org/ ]https://whales.org/ [/url]

Keep up to date with all the awesome gaming activities WDC does by signing up to their mailing list here: [url=https://games.whales.org/#newsletter]https://games.whales.org/#newsletter[/url]

And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: [url=https://bit.ly/WODSale25]https://bit.ly/WODSale25[/url]

Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC!

[i]*50% of our net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).[/i]

[h2]Why Builder Edition and what is different about it?[/h2]

Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition is a free spin off of this game. It's focus is on community built levels allowing players to make and play online levels for free. Think of Builder Edition as a nice complement to the main bringing in some fresh new created levels for all to play.

[h2]New Demo Information[/h2]

The Demo for Drop It: Block Paradise! Builder Edition has been updated, just in time for Steam Next Fest! Featuring 50 hand crafted puzzle levels, ability to create your own levels and play other user created levels online!

On March 21st 2025, Builder Edition will fully launch on Steam for free! This will contain even more levels, totaling 100 total to wet your puzzle itch, fun achievements to unlock and of course custom made levels made by you and others from around the world!

Check out the demo for the new game before it launches:

notes.title: Wacky Fun Versus Mode is now available!
notes.notes:
A special wacky and fun Versus Mode is now available for Drop It: Block Paradise for Steam players. This adds a fun mode where you and a friend are pitted against each other to see who will get 10 points first. You can see a nice gameplay video of the game mode in action to see what it will be like. As you destroy blocks, they will appear on your opponents field to hinder them and vise versa. The goal is to have your Star safely on the ground first, but sometimes it's better to let your opponent fail and be knocked out instead. So grab a friend & two controllers and play a round!

This update also updates the game with 15 brand new Bonus Levels. Also a big update that adds 2 new game mechanics to the game: Ice blocks and Wind elements. This should make things extra fun!

This new update also now makes the game fully possible in Co-Op. So you and a buddy and can play together trying to solve the levels. 

Drop It: Block Paradise contains over 200 Levels, 90 Bonus Levels, Versus Mode, Online Levels created from other players like you, and more!

notes.title: Update Notes for March 31st, 2023 - Version 2.2.1
notes.notes:
Version 2.2.1 is now live!

This update brings various improvements and performance updates to the game along with 2 major changes:

[b][u]Sound Settings[/u][/b]
Sound Settings can now be independently changed for Music / Sound Effects. So if you wish to turn down or off the Music but keep the Sound Effects, you can now do it.

[u][b]Native Controller Support![/b][/u]
Our puzzle game now natively supports controllers. This means you can fully use your controller to play the game. It's fully integrated for the Xbox Controller, Nintendo Pro Controller and Playstation Controllers. Any generic gamepad controller should hopefully work as well out of the box. If it doesn't, please let me know in the Steam Discussions. Re-mapping a controller to mimic a Xbox controller might also help.

If you happen to mapped a controller for the game to imitate Keyboard + Mouse settings, you will want to remove that and set it back to normal Gamepad mode.

While the game is now fully Gamepad compatible. You will still need access to a Keyboard/Mouse to use any Input Text fields. These are mainly in the Level Editor & Block Database when naming or searching for a level. The main game itself won't require one.

notes.title: Drop It: Block Paradise - Now Live!
notes.notes:
After a lot of work, the Steam version of our game, Drop It: Block Paradise, is now live!

Originally designed and made for the Nintendo Wii U eShop many years ago, this game has been worked on a lot over the last few months and years to add tons of features and improvements to it. Not to mention all the new content added to the game. In fact, we've been working on this game, on and off, for nearly 8 years now.

Basic rundown the of the features of the game:

[list]
[*]5 Unique Worlds
[*]150 Levels to Challenge your Wits!
[*]Special unlocks: Achievements, Music & Art
[*]Bonus Levels: 50+ Brand New Levels
[*]Chaining: A new way to complete levels with quick succession
[*]Level Editor: Create and share your own unique levels with others!
[*]Block Database: Play more levels online from around the world
[*]Cross Place & Cloud Saves support
[/list]

If you happen to own the game on Xbox One / Xbox Series consoles, you can continue where you left off with the Upload / Download Saves option. Also, although the game doesn't directly support a controller, I did share a Xbox Controller mapping of the game that you can use to help get started that helps get it close to the Xbox version of the game.

I look forward to working on the game and adding new things. I already have ideas on new game mechanics and modes that could possibly be added.
